data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 proposes a 'shared mechanism' relation but identifies the mechanism as a structural analogy: both artifacts 'treat restatement as the failure mode and falsification as the success criterion.' This is a description of two artifacts sharing a high-level evaluative posture, not a demonstration that 084384ac0b1e's verdict is produced by the same causal mechanism as SRC_004's two-dimensional protocol. The target never states what the operative mechanism in 084384ac0b1e IS, only how its functions can be reorganized, so there is no shared causal mechanism—only a shared taxonomy of failure modes.
